args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 but
actually used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in
the nightly build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values
round to the nearest even cent, matching the documented behavior.
Fix indentation error in previous commit

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` fails because `src/money.py` claims to implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212 but actually uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

With `ROUND_HALF_UP`, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returns `2.67`, but banker's rounding expects `2.66`.

## Fix
- Switched the quantize rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent, matching the documented FIN-212 behavior.
- No changes to the public interface; this corrects the implementation to match the docstring and existing tests.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `cf08676984` passed, including the previously failing test.

**Fix:** Switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_CT_HALF_EVEN`, so half-cent values now round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 → 2.66`), matching the FIN-212 spec and the existing test expectation.

**Process:**
1. Created branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even`
2. Noticed and corrected an indentation bug I introduced before running CI
3. Ran CI (run `ci-0001`) — **passed**
4. Opened PR #101 against `main`, requested review from `code-owner`
5. Got approval from the code owner
6. Merged PR #101 into `main`

The fix is now on `main` and ready for today's release.
